# `aitbc market run`

Run a software offer (Ollama/Whisper/FFmpeg/Hermes/IPFS) and pay metered escrow.

## Usage

```bash
aitbc market run [OPTIONS]
```

## Options

| Option | Type | Default | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `--offer-id-or-plugin-id` | text | — | yes | The Offer id or plugin id. |
| `--prompt` | text | — | yes | The Prompt. |
| `--max-tokens` | integer | `512` | no | Max tokens to generate (Ollama) |
| `--stream` | flag | `false` | no | Stream the response (Ollama) |
| `--language` | text | — | no | Language code for Whisper (e.g. en, de) |
| `--task` | choice | `transcribe` | no | Whisper task |
| `--transcript-format` | choice | `text` | no | Whisper output format |
| `--media-format` | text | `mp4` | no | FFmpeg output container (e.g. mp4, webm) |
| `--codec` | text | `h264` | no | FFmpeg target codec (e.g. h264, vp9) |
| `--resolution` | text | `1080p` | no | FFmpeg target resolution (e.g. 1080p, 720p) |
| `--bitrate` | text | `5M` | no | FFmpeg target bitrate (e.g. 5M, 10M) |
| `--max-time` | integer | `300` | no | Maximum wall-clock execution time in seconds for Hermes jobs |
| `--days` | integer | `1` | no | Rental duration in days for IPFS hosting |
| `--pin`, `--no-pin` | flag | `true` | no | Pin the CID for IPFS hosting (default: pin) |
| `--track` | flag | `false` | no | Create a coordinator job record after a successful run |
| `--proposer` | text | — | no | Override the escrow node-wallet address (defaults to the node wallet advertised at /health) |
| `--output` | choice | — | no | Output format (alias for --format) |
| `--format` | choice | — | no | Output format |

## Examples

```bash
aitbc market run --offer-id-or-plugin-id <offer_id_or_plugin_id> --prompt <prompt>
aitbc market run --offer-id-or-plugin-id <offer_id_or_plugin_id> --prompt <prompt> --output json
```
